profile.headline: SWE @ Fidelity Investments
profile.summary:
Ever since I was a kid I have been endlessly enamored by all things relating to technology. I never thought of it as a possible career until my high school pre-engineering field trip to Google. After my high school graduation, I started to teach myself HTML and CSS while building a website and knew I needed to learn more about programming.

I am currently pursuing a BA in Computer Science with a minor in Data Science. My favorite thing about programming is being able to express my creativity while creating meaningful and impactful projects. Most of my experience is in iOS development but I love taking on new challenges to grow.
